subject: Phase120 LOCKED RAR / GSG gradient-gate function and its constants

functional_form.provenance_note: Quoted verbatim from the frozen artifact fields, not reconstructed. The 'RAR function' in this programme is the McGaugh+2016 nu-function at the Phase120 a0; the Phase120 GSG prediction additionally multiplies the MOND-minus-Newton boost by a gradient-keyed (Vainshtein-style) gate G_L.

g_RAR.value: nu(Y)=1/(1-exp(-sqrt(Y))) via g_RAR=g_bar/(1-exp(-sqrt(g_bar/A0_P120))) with small-Y Taylor branch.

g_RAR_reference_implementation.verbatim_docstring: McGaugh+ 2016 fitting function: g = g_b / (1 - exp(-sqrt(g_b/a0))).
g_RAR_reference_implementation.small_x_branch: for x = sqrt(g_bar/a0) <= 1e-3 the code returns sqrt(a0*g_bar) exactly (Taylor limit), not the ratio form

reference_implementation.verbatim_docstring: Gradient-keyed (Vainshtein-style) screening: S(L_b) = 1 - exp(-(L_b / L_star)^q) where L_b = |g_b| / |grad g_b| is the local gradient scale.

L_b_convention.value: total baryonic log-gradient: L_b = R / max(abs(d ln g_bar / d ln R), 1e-3), matching 206_phase120_cohort_residuals.py
L_b_convention.warning: TWO gradient-scale conventions exist on disk in this programme and differ on exactly one SPARC row. The one above is the frozen Phase120 convention. Do not substitute the linear-gradient form L_b = g_bar/abs(dg_bar/dR), which appears only inside the W-window definition (see w_window below).

F_P120_activation_fraction.denominator_policy: No epsilon, no clipping, no forced [0,1]; valid only on frozen W rows with finite g_bar/g_RAR/g_GSG and denom > 0.

B_chi_status.value: No component-specific Bchi exists in the verified recovered Phase120 cohort implementation; recovered implementation uses total G_L gate multiplying g_RAR - g_bar.
B_chi_status.note: chi_star and p (below) parameterise the B_chi source gate, which is NOT part of the executed Phase120 residual chain.

upstream_origin.provenance_note: a0, L_star and q in Set B are the linear posteriors of the Phase120 latent-mixture MCMC refit (163 galaxies, 3269 radii, 48 walkers, 115200 samples). This is where the extra digits come from; they are NOT a re-rounding of Set A.

chi_star_and_p_meaning.provenance_note: chi_star and p do NOT enter G_L. They parameterise the B_chi source-gate sigmoid, whose fiducial point is chi_* = 1, p = 2.
chi_star_and_p_meaning.verbatim_code: def B_chi_sigmoid(chi_B, chi_star, p): return cb_p / (chi_star ** p + cb_p)  # cb_p = chi_B ** p
chi_star_and_p_meaning.warning: B_chi is NOT part of the executed Phase120 residual chain (see functional_form.B_chi_status). Carrying chi_star/p in a 'locked RAR function' file is therefore descriptive of the theory, not of the code that produced any Phase120 number.
